desc: Ideation: identify structural facts, order preservation, gap effects, and candidate approaches.
Formalize the gap-reduction covering model for a fixed ordered partition of initial pieces to target 1-squares, including exact feasibility and minimum operation count with translation.
Implement small brute-force BFS for tiny N to generate ground-truth answers and test the gap-reduction model and candidate counterexamples.
Design an optimization/DP over ordered piece-to-target partitions using the validated gap model.
Derive an efficient O(N) or O(N log N) algorithm from the DP/model, including binary search if needed.
Implement the full Python solution with fast I/O and validate on samples and edge cases.
